pr_title: fix: allow nested `<dt>`/`<dd>` elements if they are within a `<dl>` element
pr_body:
This introduces a resets array, which means descendants that are forbidden are allowed again, if an element within the resets array is encountered between the tag and the forbidden descendant

fixes #12676

I'm not sure if I understand the test to it's full extend, but since quite some time divs are allowed as children of dl: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/dl#wrapping_name-value_groups_in_div_elements

issue_context.title: `<dt>` is invalid inside `<dd>`
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

As of svelte 5-next.201, the following code gives the error  `<dt> is invalid inside <dd>`

```
<dl>
    <dt>Address</dt>
    <dd>
        <dl class="horizontal gap:row:0">
            <dt>Street</dt>          <dd>29 Acacia Road</dd>
            <dt>Town</dt>            <dd>Beanotown</dd>
            <dt>Postcode</dt>        <dd>BE1 0WN</dd>
        </dl>
    </dd>
</dl>
```

So long as there is a `<dl>` wrapper, then nesting should be allowed.

### Reproduction

https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAACm2QTWvDMAyG_4rQOZButxovkMGupWyDHZodjKVuBtcKtrqylv73kXiDtuz2fuiRQCfchsgFzeaEye0YDfbjiA3q9ziZ8sVRGRssss9-SizFbkhgSbueKHMptiWdIgCwRL-qugg-ulIeBvyUHI6S1EX4cKPJcjCLAS-GK6Ddi2ZmnXdeFtTdL6H3zgcHz-LItlen_uhXOaQbttKP7JJobf8D11LUC_EVPINPd7B4W91gtq1vqHJq5gQb3AmFbWBCo3nP5_fzD7Jr-LBjAQAA

_No response_

```shell

```

comments:
> @dummdidumm [3bff87a](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/commit/3bff87ac66251c60a92cf244d54aeb8ad8ece5d6) 👀

I looked at that but the argument is that the browser may add missing elements such as a `<tbody>`.  That doesn't apply in this case as the above example is perfectly valid HTML and won't be changed by the browser. 

So long as the nested elements are wrapped by a `<dl>` they are valid.
I was pointing out the commit that likely broke it. I was not arguing that it's not valid.

review_comments: We should just be able to check `disallowed.reset_by` without checking `'reset_by' in disallowed`. Is this to keep TS happy about something?
